title: Among molecules that contain at least one sodium atom and are carcinogenic,
question: Among molecules that contain at least one sodium atom and are carcinogenic, which elements appear in double bonds?

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_003"
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_005"
WHERE T2."XCL_011" = '+'
  AND T3."XCL_006" = '='
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN (SELECT "XCL_002" FROM atom WHERE "XCL_003" = 'na')
